name: LDLC
verdict: The LDLC brand belongs to Groupe LDLC, a French e-commerce group traded on Euronext Growth and controlled by its founding family, de la Clergerie. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: naming partner of ASVEL since 2018 (the club plays as LDLC ASVEL); LDLC.com says the partnership runs until 2028 (https://www.ldlc.com/n4720/ldlc-asvel). The only shareholders above 5% are members of the de la Clergerie family (annual report 2025-2026); no state in the chain and no human-rights finding found.
